title: Australia’s Stock Market Seen as AI Haven
description:
Australia's stock market maybe emerging as a rare safe haven from the AI-driven volatility rattling Asian equities.
A nascent rally has pushed valuations to the brink of overtaking India as the Asia-Pacific's priciest major market for the first time in six years.
Shaw and Partners Asset Management's Investment Director Julia Lee joins "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" to discuss what this means for index heavyweights like BHP and CSL.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Leaning Into AI Helps VC Founders, Says Revolution's Hall
description: David Hall, managing partner at Revolution, talks about how artificial intelligence is helping  entrepreneurs of color compete. He speaks with Romaine Bostick at the Bloomberg New Voices event in Martha's Vineyard. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Crypto CEOs, Surviving Crypto Winter | Bloomberg Crypto 8/18/2026
description: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Raghu Yarlagadda, FalconX CEO, Carlos Domingo, Securitize CEO, Yesha Yadav, Vanderbilt Law School Associate Dean and Professor of Law, Kavita Gupta, Delta Blockchain Fund Founder and General Partner, and Anthony Soohoo, MoneyGram CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)
